status: design only; no implementation in this audit

designInvariants.detail: No CodeFuse source, case id, function name, address, binary digest or reference text may appear in this suite. CodeFuse remains an external scoreboard that is never a merge requirement and never an oracle. The suite must be able to pass while the CodeFuse score is unchanged or worse.

Fixed sources, fixed toolchain identity, fixed value sets, no wall-clock thresholds inside assertions. Tier 0 proves determinism by running the same corpus twice and requiring byte-identical observations.

Every fixture records compiler/linker identity, target triple, argv, optimization level, debug state, source sha256 and binary sha256, plus a copy-pasteable rebuild command. A rebuild that changes the digest invalidates the frozen baseline as one transaction.
The case set is a closed enumeration (32 declared items across 4 tiers). Value sets are finite and listed in the manifest. No case is discovered dynamically at run time.
Tier 0 <= 5 s, Tier 1 <= 60 s, Tier 2 <= 90 s. Total added per-PR cost target <= 2.5 min. Tier 3 never runs in the per-PR path.
Tier 3 is a separate opt-in command with its own budget and its own generated (but deterministic) inputs, bounded by work units rather than wall clock.

Every case declares an oracle whose authority is stated, whose implementation is not the product, and which is self-tested by a deliberately wrong sentinel that must be rejected before the case can run.

Semantic metrics (semantic-path retention, oracle equivalence, unknown preservation) are merge-blocking. Presentation metrics (rendered length, goto count, readability vector) are reported and can only fail through a frozen-baseline regression rule, never on their own.
Nine counters must be exactly zero; a non-zero counter is blocking, and a counter that cannot be evaluated (missing tool, missing artifact, empty corpus) is itself a blocked run, not a zero.

designInvariants.rule: no overfit to current output strings
designInvariants.detail: No assertion may compare against a specific rendered string produced by the current implementation. Assertions are on the oracle-visible semantic contract; frozen-baseline comparison is allowed only as a non-regression direction (must not get worse), never as equality-against-current-output.
The suite extends the existing 12-case / 6-recipe competitive-arm64 foundation and reuses the existing fixture/provenance/oracle/counter disciplines instead of creating a parallel format.

A missing compiler, target library, or language lane blocks the suite (adopting tools/validation/machine-effects/prerequisites.mjs fail-closed semantics) and is recorded in a counted excluded-by-environment set that may never be silently empty.

provenanceSchema.claimTemplate: Owned compiler-produced AArch64 fixture. Not CodeFuse, competitor, browser, physical-device or reference-text evidence.
provenanceSchema.precedent: tests/scpa/fixtures/threaded-integer.json (schema scpa-owned-assembled-fixture/v1) plus tools/validation/phase8/build-corpus.mjs toolchain recording

tiers.name: micro invariant
tiers.purpose: Prove the suite cannot lie about itself, in seconds, with no compiler.
tiers.distributionMeasurement: measured analog: tests/phase8/provenance/safety-counter-style checks run in single-digit seconds

cases.assertion: Two independent in-process runs of the Tier 1 observation corpus produce byte-identical observations; any difference increments nonDeterminismCount.
cases.reuse: tools/validation/phase8/metrics.mjs determinismFailures + MEASUREMENT_TIME_BUDGET_MS (one shared budget, not two)

cases.assertion: For every declared oracle, a deliberately mutated expectation is rejected before the case is admitted.
cases.reuse: tools/competitive-arm64/manifest.mjs wrong-oracle sentinel pattern (checkU64Add7 good/bad pair)

cases.assertion: The oracle's integer/flag model reproduces hand-computed wrap, carry and overflow vectors; the oracle must not import product semantics.
Every declared case has a source digest, an artifact digest, an oracle identity and a rebuild command; a case with a missing field is counted, not skipped.

The declared prerequisite set is enumerated as a set; an unsatisfied member blocks the run and is reported in excludedByEnvironment. A green run with a non-empty excludedByEnvironment is a blocked run, not a pass.
cases.motivatedBy: OBS-3 in gap-matrix.json (compiler-truth exits 0 while the Swift lane is skipped)

tiers.name: end-to-end ARM64
tiers.purpose: Close G-01: a compiler-produced ARM64 binary must reach the shared semantic path through the shipped decoder, and recovered semantics must match an independent source-level oracle.
tiers.executionMode: owned C source -> AArch64 object -> linked minimal ELF (recorded argv) -> real loader -> shipped Capstone decode -> shared semantic pipeline -> public query/decompile facade

oracle.authority: source-level contract evaluated by a test-owned interpreter over a finite value set

cases.contract: u64 + u64 wraparound at the 64-bit boundary
cases.overfitGuard: value set chosen from the arithmetic boundary, not from an observed render

cases.contract: signed/unsigned extension matrix across 8/16/32/64-bit operands
store then load at the same address; a clobbering unknown call must break the store-load link
array-of-struct stride and field offset recovery with distinct byte offsets
goto-based dispatcher producing a multi-entry loop; recovered structure must keep all reachable blocks
counted loop with a mid-body break; iteration count and exit condition observable in the oracle
nested loop with an induction variable pair
dense switch compiled to a table branch; all case targets must be recovered
sparse switch compiled to a compare chain; the default arm must remain distinct from the cases
function-pointer dispatch through an unresolvable target; the unknown must stay explicitly open rather than being folded to one target
floating-point accumulation or clamp with a declared mathematical result over a finite value set
vector reduction expressed with an independently computed expected result

semantic: the shared semantic path is used (not a legacy fallback)
oracle equivalence over the declared finite value set
raw-assembly escalation count does not increase over the frozen baseline
presentation: reported only: rendered length, goto count, readability vector
may fail a merge only through an explicit frozen-baseline regression rule, never by absolute value

tiers.strippedTwin: each Tier 1 case is also run against an allowlisted strip-only copy; the invariant is 'a declared-exact result must not degrade silently, and a symbol-dependent claim must become explicitly unknown rather than wrong'

tiers.name: ABI / language
tiers.purpose: Close G-08 (ABI at a real call site) and G-02/G-03 (Swift, Rust, Go lanes) using the existing six recipes as the inventory of record.

cases.contract: homogeneous float aggregate passed by value; register bank assignment must match the AAPCS64 rule derived from the rule text
17-byte aggregate return crossing the register/stack boundary
variadic call with mixed integer and floating arguments; word-slot accounting
large aggregate return via an indirect result pointer (x8)
wide integral argument split across a register pair
over-aligned aggregate forced to the stack
open-world virtual dispatch must remain open (reuses the existing virtual_open recipe, executed against a linked binary)
dynamic selector dispatch must remain open (reuses selector_open)
generic witness dispatch (reuses witnessOpen)
slice bounds check on a fat pointer (reuses slice_bounds)
interface dispatch and closure capture (reuses ClosureCapture)

tiers.laneSetRule: The six lanes are declared as a SET. `npm run arm64-generalization:tier2` requires every lane to be present-and-bound; an unbound lane blocks the run and is counted, it is never skipped (D-I12, motivated by OBS-3).

tiers.name: pathological / stress
tiers.purpose: Bound resource behaviour without endangering the per-PR budget.

cases.contract: deterministically generated single function with a declared work-unit bound; asserts completion within the bound and an unchanged result set
deeply nested control flow with a declared bound on recovered structure size
the existing sha256-pinned large iOS images (tests/fixtures/real-binaries.json) analyzed with an explicit resource ceiling
many-function binary discovery with a declared bound on time and on unproven extents, reported as explicit unknown rather than dropped

hardZeroCounters.definition: a case that used the shared semantic path in the frozen baseline no longer does
recovered semantics differ from the independent source-level oracle over the declared finite value set
a declared-unknown result is presented as a definite answer
per-case raw-assembly row count increased over the frozen baseline
a published completeness/ledger claims complete for a case without a semantic path
a withheld ledger carries transform claims
a declared case lacks a source digest, artifact digest, oracle identity or rebuild command
two Tier 0 runs of the same corpus disagree
a declared prerequisite is unsatisfied; blocking, and never allowed to be non-empty on a green run

benchmarkOverfitPreventionRules.rule: Forbidden: copying any CodeFuse-declared case name, function name, address, binary digest or reference text into this suite.
Forbidden: using another tool's output (IDA, or any reference .c) as an oracle. Oracles must be source-level contracts or architecture-rule-derived expectations.
Forbidden: asserting against a specific rendered string of the current implementation.
Forbidden: making CodeFuse score improvement a merge condition. The suite must pass with an unchanged or worse CodeFuse score.
Required: the source set, the oracle type and the optimization set must each differ from CodeFuse's frozen shape (C-only sources, IDA reference, {O0,O1,O2,O3,Os} x {g,no_g}).
Required: every case states why its assertion cannot be satisfied by memorizing the current product output (an explicit overfitGuard note in the manifest).
Required: holdout discipline. Tier 1/2 sources are owned and must not be published as a scored corpus; CodeFuse remains the only published external scoreboard.

openQuestionsForMergeDecision: Which lane owns the existing red ARM64 provenance test (OBS-1) before a new suite may cite Phase 8 ARM64 coverage?

Does the decoded-instruction route for ARM64 need a production provider before Tier 1 can be expressed, or should Tier 1 initially assert through the existing decompile() facade and mark the decoded route as an explicit remaining unknown?
Which tier becomes merge-blocking first: Tier 1 only, or Tier 0 + Tier 1 together?
